operational_goals.title: Complete IoT device inventory
operational_goals.description: Discover and register every IoT device across Wi-Fi, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter, and BLE. Every device must have a complete entry in device-registry.json including protocol, IP/MAC or IEEE address, firmware, mqtt_topic, and VLAN.
operational_goals.success_criteria: All devices visible via 'navig skill run device-discover' and 'zigbee-scan', all registered in device-registry.json, all correlated to their MQTT topics.

operational_goals.title: Establish the morning mesh sweep
operational_goals.description: Configure the morning-mesh-sweep workflow to run automatically at 07:00 daily. Results (new devices, offline devices, segmentation glance) should be written to memory and the inbox.
operational_goals.success_criteria: Workflow runs on schedule, produces a readable summary, anomalies surface as entries in known-issues.json.

operational_goals.title: Enforce IoT VLAN segmentation
operational_goals.description: Move all IoT devices onto the isolated IoT VLAN (20) and confirm they cannot initiate connections into the trusted LAN. Maintain segmentation.md and iot-port-baseline.json.
operational_goals.success_criteria: vlan-audit passes: every device inside the IoT subnet, isolation probe fails as intended, no boundary crossings.

operational_goals.title: Map and secure the MQTT bus
operational_goals.description: Map the full topic tree, correlate every topic to a registered device, disable anonymous broker access, and document retained messages. Maintain mqtt-topics.md.
operational_goals.success_criteria: mqtt-topics.md fully populated, no orphan topics, anonymous MQTT rejected, credentials in the vault.

operational_goals.title: Bring the fleet to current firmware
operational_goals.description: Run a firmware audit, resolve any CVE exposure via staged OTA rollouts, and eliminate version drift across Tasmota/ESPHome/Shelly devices.
operational_goals.success_criteria: No device on CVE-affected firmware; drift limited to non-critical devices; every flash verified and recorded in the registry.

operational_goals.title: Baseline every device's open ports
operational_goals.description: Fill iot-port-baseline.json for every device class in the registry so the security-mesh formation can flag unexpected listeners.
operational_goals.success_criteria: Every registered device matches a device_classes entry; the weekly security-review raises no unbaselined ports.
